description:
Use this when the user asks for NSE's own market cap and shares in issue, for one company over time or the largest companies on a day.

Returns NSE's published market capitalisation, shares in issue and face value. With `symbol` (an NSE symbol): that security day by day over `days` (default 30, at most 1825) or `from_date` and `to_date`; `date` and `limit` are then ignored. Without `symbol`: the `limit` largest companies (1 to 100, default 25) on `date` (default the latest day held), with NSE's totals for the market; the window arguments are then ignored. NSE publishes it from 1 February 2024; stored depth depends on seeding.
name: get_market_cap_history
title: NSE market capitalisation
